## Objective
The objective of this script is to map the aiforia combos output to individual fragments and split them up by component model.

### Input
- *subset_<subset_name>.json* (fe_si_images/output/process_subset/)
- *fragments_inlcuded_subset>.json*
- *<image_name>_fragments.geojson*(fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/)
fragment coordinates 
- *<image_name>_<model_version>_processed_ia_results.geojson* (fe_si_platforms/aiforia/output/ai_results)


### Output
- *<image_name>_<fragment_name>_<model_version>_<component_model>.geojson*
- *<image_name>_<fragment_name>_fragments.geojson*

### Issues /Deviations / comments
- changed the name of epithelium/lamina propria models (and judits_work_keller_lab) from _tissue_ to _compartments_ and added model_version to output files to keep track of origin. Will have to rename / reprocess already processed files.
-errors when processing the larger images on PC (lenovo) but not on macbook

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
Sys.setenv(OGR_GEOJSON_MAX_OBJ_SIZE = 0)

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"
#to_box <- "C:/Users/15303/Box/" #JMW lenovo

#This function takes a vector of image names and arranges them by file size for a model_version output
arrange_image_names <- function(image_names, model_version, ia_results_dir){
  #Expected file names
  expected_files <- paste(image_names, model_version, "processed_ia_results.geojson", sep = "_")
  
  #List actual files in directory
  actual_files <- list.files(ia_results_dir)
  
  #Identify downloaded images
  downloaded_image_results <- image_names[expected_files %in% actual_files]
  
  #Initialize empty df
  downloaded_image_files <- data.frame(
    image_name = character(),
    file_path = character(),
    file_size_mb = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  #Populate df
  for (image in downloaded_image_results){
    file_path <- paste0(ia_results_dir, image, "_", model_version, "_processed_ia_results.geojson")
    
    #Get file size in MB
    file_size_mb <- file.info(file_path)$size / (1024^2)
    
    #Create df row
    downloaded_image_file <- data.frame(
      image_name = image,
      file_path = file_path,
      file_size_mb = file_size_mb,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    #Append to df
    downloaded_image_files <- rbind(downloaded_image_files, downloaded_image_file)
  }
  
  
  #Arrange by file size (smallest first)
  downloaded_image_files <- downloaded_image_files %>%
    arrange(file_size_mb)
  
  return(downloaded_image_files)
}

process_image_fragments <- function(image_names, model_version, ia_results_dir, fragments_dir, output_dir, included_fragments) {

  arranged_images <- arrange_image_names(image_names, model_version, ia_results_dir)
  arranged_image_names <- unique(arranged_images$image_name)

  files <- list.files(output_dir)

  not_in_files <- arranged_image_names[
    !vapply(
      arranged_image_names,
      function(image) any(startsWith(files, image)),
      logical(1)
    )
  ]

  no_fragments_with_si_layers <- c()

  for (image in not_in_files){
    cat("Processing image", image, "\n")

    file_data <- arranged_images %>% filter(image_name == image)

    image_combos <- st_read(file_data$file_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_set_crs(0) %>%
      #add confidence pct to name
      mutate(
        name = paste0(
          str_replace_all(tolower(name), " ", "_"),
          "_conf_pct_",
          round(confidence_percentage)))

    image_layers <- image_combos %>%
      filter(classification %in% c("villi", "crypts"))

    image_compartments <- image_combos %>%
      filter(classification %in% c("epithelium", "lumen", "lamina_propria"))

    image_lymphocytes <- image_combos %>%
      filter(classification == "lymphocytes")
    
    image_fragments_included <- included_fragments %>% filter(image_name == image)

    fragment_path <- file.path(fragments_dir, paste0(image, "_fragments.geojson"))

    image_fragments <- st_read(fragment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_set_crs(0) %>%
      rename(fragment_name = name) %>%
      select(-classification, -exclusion_reason, -id, -included) %>%
      filter(fragment_name %in% image_fragments_included$fragment_name)

    # Function to match fragments
    match_fragments <- function(target_data, fragments){
      intersection_indices <- st_intersects(target_data, fragments, sparse = TRUE)
      indices <- sapply(intersection_indices, function(x) if (length(x) > 0) x[1] else NA)
      valid_indices <- !is.na(indices)

      matched_data <- target_data[valid_indices, ] %>%
        filter(st_geometry_type(.) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON"))

      st_intersection(matched_data, fragments)
    }

    layers_by_fragment <- match_fragments(image_layers, image_fragments)
    compartments_by_fragment <- match_fragments(image_compartments, image_fragments)
    lymphocytes_by_fragment <- match_fragments(image_lymphocytes, image_fragments)

    for (fragment in image_fragments$fragment_name){
      fragment_fragment <- image_fragments %>% filter(fragment_name == fragment)
      fragment_layers <- layers_by_fragment %>% filter(fragment_name == fragment)
      fragment_compartments <- compartments_by_fragment %>% filter(fragment_name == fragment)
      fragment_lymphocytes <- lymphocytes_by_fragment %>% filter(fragment_name == fragment)

      # Writing outputs
      st_write(fragment_fragment,
               file.path(output_dir, paste0(image, "_", fragment, "_fragment.geojson")),
               quiet = TRUE,
               delete_dsn = TRUE)

      st_write(fragment_layers,
               file.path(output_dir, paste0(image, "_", fragment, "_", model_version,"_layers.geojson")),
               quiet = TRUE,
               delete_dsn = TRUE)

      st_write(fragment_compartments,
               file.path(output_dir, paste0(image, "_", fragment, "_", model_version,"_compartments.geojson")),
               quiet = TRUE,
               delete_dsn = TRUE)

      st_write(fragment_lymphocytes,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0(image, "_", fragment, "_", model_version,"_lymphocytes.geojson")),
               quiet = TRUE,
               delete_dsn = TRUE)
    }
  }

  cat("Processing completed.\n")
}
```

subset_name <- "grading_sample"

  mutate(image_fragment_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep = "_"))

### Process image fragment for labl_2020_tuning model fe_si_combos_pv2_mv2
Processes image fragments for labl_2020 tuning image if the results for the corresponding model has been downloaded

#### Issues/Deviations
Got errors when processing the larger images on PC (lenovo) but not on macbook

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
subset_labl_2020_tuning <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box,"judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_tuning.json"))

image_names <- subset_labl_2020_tuning$image_name

model_version <- "fe_si_combos_pv2_mv2"

combos_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/combos/output/aiforia_ia_results/")

fragments_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/")

output_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/combos/output/combos_duplicate/")


process_image_fragments(image_names, model_version, combos_dir, fragments_dir, output_dir)
```
